detailed_description: Cover Letter Generator - Create a concise first draft for a specific role using the job title, company name, experience summary, skills, one achievement, and a selected tone. The tool turns those fields into a structured letter with an opening, evidence paragraph, and closing line, giving applicants a quick base to edit for the exact job posting rather than starting from a blank page.
usage_steps: Enter the job title, company, relevant experience, skills, and one measurable achievement
Choose a tone such as professional, friendly, persuasive, or concise
Review the generated letter draft in the output area
Copy the draft and personalize names, facts, and role-specific details before sending
usage_examples: Draft a short cover letter for a product manager application
Turn a resume achievement into a more persuasive application paragraph
Compare a concise version with a friendlier tone before editing the final letter

faqs.question: Is the Cover Letter Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The generator runs in the browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does this submit my application anywhere?
faqs.answer: No. It only creates text on the page. You decide where to copy, edit, and send the final version.

faqs.question: Do I still need to edit the draft?
faqs.answer: Yes. Review the draft for accuracy, add job-specific details, and remove anything that does not match your real experience.
